```plato

// A rigid placement in space: position plus orientation. Also known as a 3D
// rigid transform (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rigid_transformation);
// composition preserves distances and angles.
type Pose3D
    implements IValue, IInterpolatable, IRigid3D
{
    Position: Point3D;
    Orientation: Quaternion;
}
```
